items.headline: Our customer support agent was failing silently for weeks — here's what actually fixed it
items.summary: Built a customer support agent for a SaaS product earlier this year. Ticket routing, refund handling, account issues — the usual scope. It worked well enough in staging, went live, and for the first few weeks the deflection numbers looked fine. Then I started reading the actual transcripts. items.headline: Combined Karpathy's LLM Wiki with Milla Jovovich`s MemPalace MCP. Claude Code now remembers everything across sessions
items.summary: If you use Claude Code for anything serious, you know the pain. Every new session = blank slate. Your CLAUDE.md helps, but it's static. The real context - decisions you made, ideas you explored, connections you discovered - all gone. I built a system that fixes this. It's called Memoriki - a template that combines two open source projects: Layer 1: LLM Wiki (Karpathy's pattern) You drop raw sources into a folder (articles, transcripts, notes, whatever). items.headline: Capturing Unseen Spatial Heat Extremes Through Dependence-Aware Generative Modeling
items.summary:
arXiv:2507.09211v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Observed records of climate extremes provide an incomplete view of risk, missing "unseen" events beyond historical experience. Ignoring spatial dependence further underestimates hazards striking multiple locations simultaneously.
